name: Balkan Bäckerei
kurzbeschreibung:
**Balkan Bäckerei in Schwaz**

Discover the vibrant flavors of the Balkans at **Balkan Bäckerei** in the charming town of **Schwaz**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. This cozy bakery brings you a taste of the region’s rich culinary traditions with freshly baked goods, aromatic spices, and warm hospitality.

From flaky **Burek** to sweet **Baklava**, every treat here is crafted with care, blending authentic Balkan tastes with the welcoming atmosphere of the **Zillertal** valley. Whether you're stopping by for a quick snack or a leisurely coffee break, **Balkan Bäckerei** promises a delightful experience that’s as hearty as it is delicious.

Located centrally in **Schwaz**, it’s the perfect spot to fuel up before exploring the historic streets, visiting the **Schwazer Silberbergwerk**, or taking a scenic hike through the stunning **Kitzbüheler Alpen**. Come taste the world—one bite at a time!
